Name: LGRC / Lung Genomics Research Consortium
Description: Large ILD cohort (IPF and other interstitial lung disease vs control). Primary bulk discovery cohort for reproducible IPF signature.

Name: Furrer / Yang IPF-CHP-control RNA-seq
Description: Bulk RNA-seq of IPF, chronic hypersensitivity pneumonitis and controls. Second discovery cohort for cross-cohort replication.

Name: IPF vs control lung RNA-seq
Description: External bulk RNA-seq validation / etiology-sensitivity check.

Name: Habermann et al. 2020 (Vanderbilt/TGen) pulmonary fibrosis atlas
Description: Main donor-level cell-type pseudobulk localization layer. 114,396 cells, 20 PF and 10 control lungs, 31 cell subsets incl. aberrant epithelial and multiple fibroblast states. DOI 10.1126/sciadv.aba1972.

Name: Adams et al. 2020 (Yale) IPF cell atlas
Description: Directional external single-cell support. 312,928 cells; 32 IPF, controls, COPD. Aberrant basaloid cells, IPF myofibroblasts, profibrotic macrophages. DOI 10.1126/sciadv.aba1983.

Name: LINCS L1000 / L1000FWD perturbational signatures
Description: Drug-repositioning hypothesis generation by connectivity/signature reversal. Use a downloaded L1000 signature matrix (offline mode) or the L1000FWD/CLUE API (online mode).
